# CUTLASS DSL 4.4.0-4.4.2 has divergent libs-base/libs-cu13 payloads at the
# same paths. If libs-base's _cutlass_ir.so wins, SM12x MmaMXF4NVF4Op lowering
# emits malformed "_mma" PTX and FlashInfer B12X NVFP4 JIT fails with
# "Unexpected instruction types specified for '_mma'". Install libs-cu13 so
# the working 4.4.2 payload overrides libs-base. NVIDIA tracks this as
# https://github.com/NVIDIA/cutlass/issues/3170 (also listed in the 4.6.0 fixes:
# https://github.com/NVIDIA/cutlass/discussions/3385).
# This selects only the CUTLASS DSL runtime/JIT payload; it does not replace the
# CUDA toolkit, Torch cu129, or RTP-LLM's Bazel --config=cuda12_9 compilation.
# CUDA 12.9 remains supported per NVIDIA's compatibility documentation:
# https://docs.nvidia.com/cutlass/latest/media/docs/pythonDSL/quick_start.html
# must run `pip install nvidia-cutlass-dsl-libs-cu13==4.4.2 --force-reinstall` to override any previous install
nvidia-cutlass-dsl-libs-cu13==4.4.2
